recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Revisit only if concrete resource pages stop rendering equivalent resource-specific extension links or if the work group makes a new decision to give standard extensions more prominence than the option-2 link approach.
issue_request: FHIR-16525 was Published/Not Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to list standard extensions for each resource on resource Contents pages, but the accepted modification rejected a full list and focused on cleaning up duplicate extension-link placement while Eric Haas gathered feedback on mockups.
initial_application: Git commit 8a424ffcc6b1cf70bba4af7e5221930a2f6ca51e, tied to SVN revision 14576, applied GF#16525 by adding a resource-page Profiles & Extensions link through the then-active source template and publisher macro rather than adding embedded extension tables.
additional_context: The GF#16525 Zulip thread contrasted option 2, a link below the content view, with option 3, a full extension table. Feedback warned that extension tables could be long and over-prominent. FHIR-20637 later adopted option 2 and is already audited on the combined branch; its implementation retitled the paragraph as Additional definitions while preserving concrete resource extension-link hooks.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/fhir.ini lists active resources, tools/templates/template.html contains the [%ext-link%] placeholder in the Additional definitions line, and current CI rendering for Patient and Observation shows Extensions navigation plus see-the-extensions links below resource content.
